reviewer: measurement-review, leaf 1.1.3, independent from the sampler author

wrong_hash_negative_control.evidence_type: current-source in-process rejection with run and Popen mocked to forbid launches

cleanup_controls.evidence_type: real Python child process, not the GUI workload

acceptance.median_implementation: Independent sorted-values median, not the sampler summary function
acceptance.raw_immutability_control: Expected raw SHA256 checked before and after dynamic controls

initial_isolated_red_control.cause: The pre-resume oracle incorrectly resolved legacy recorded paths against the isolated worktree.
initial_isolated_red_control.repair_scope: Only measure2-acceptance.py path binding and required value-card/limit coverage; raw evidence and sampler were not edited.

lint.observed_error: ruff: The term 'ruff' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program.

value_card.protects: M02 raw arithmetic, source identity, baseline integrity, and launch-owned cleanup
value_card.fails_when: A sample, digest, summary, PID birth identity, rejection, or Git baseline changes
value_card.why_new: Existing focused checks omit all-sample, environment, hash, wrong-hash, and mutation reconciliation
value_card.seam: None in production; wrong-hash launches are stubbed only inside the test process
value_card.no_claim: No GUI rerun, paint/readiness, renderer/true peak, Brave equivalence, startup/navigation, or production-budget verdict

observed: Seven recorded runs contain twenty samples each, with one extant process in every recorded sample.
Current EXE, fixture, and sampler fingerprints match the recorded identities; EXE and fixture before/after records are equal.
The seven recorded PID/create-time identities are not alive now.
Current-source wrong-hash rejection and real Python-child cleanup controls passed without launching the GUI.
derived: All per-run final and sampled-peak fields and all five median/min/max summaries recompute exactly from raw samples.
No renderer child was observed at the 250 ms sampling interval; this is a sampling result, not proof that no renderer ran.
Final samples occurred 4768.742600001133 to 4987.052600001334 ms after Popen initiation.
not_established: Renderer lifetime, renderer memory, exited-child CPU, or true whole-process-tree peaks
First meaningful paint, page readiness, navigation timing, interaction, frame pacing, or startup-to-paint
Cold startup, controlled cache state, energy use, active/multitab/recovery behavior, or production memory budgets
Equivalent Brave functionality, comparative advantage, reduction ratios, or a fastest/lightest claim
A reproducible build from the historical source revision or a performance claim for later development source

limitations: All 140 samples contain only the retained GUI root. A one-shot renderer can exit between 250 ms observations, so renderer resource use and true process-tree peaks remain unknown.
Hidden-window process survival and headless fixture inspection do not establish paint or page readiness.
Sampled peaks are maxima of the recorded root-only observations, not true peaks; transient or inaccessible descendants can be missed.
Popen duration is process creation only. Final-sample elapsed times are not startup, navigation, or readiness metrics.
Working-set sums can count shared pages more than once. CPU fields cover only extant sampled processes and omit exited-child CPU.
Power saver, available RAM, host background work, and cache conditions were not controlled. No cold-cache result follows.
The raw report does not record viewport, DPI, fonts, or a background-process inventory requested by BENCHMARKS.md; this is an environment-capture gap for future comparisons.
Creation-time checks and the Popen handle constrain cleanup to owned identities, but children never observed cannot be included in that evidence.
The immutable 0.2 local subset lacks retained full-browser functionality. No equivalent Brave comparison, performance advantage, or production budget is justified.
This review reconciled existing evidence and non-GUI controls; it did not rerun or independently reproduce the GUI workload.
root_actions: Preserve the raw report, existing sampler/checks, and Brave baseline as immutable inputs; integrate this only as a local crew candidate, not formal READY.
If root records these values in BENCHMARKS.md or TASKS.md, retain the renderer-sampling, environment-capture, paint-readiness, and non-equivalence limits.

Measure a future new workload with explicit paint/navigation readiness, high-resolution renderer-lifetime instrumentation, viewport/DPI/font/background capture, and full-process-tree active/peak/recovery metrics before any comparison.
Keep formal gstack receipt/READY/ship gates open because their helper runtime and remote policy are unavailable.
